DECISION: Remove all light/system theme support from Whisnap, hardcode dark theme everywhere
OPTIONS: Keep theme switcher, keep light theme, keep system detection
REASONING: Simplification — app is dark-only, no need for user choice or system detection

FILES DELETED:
- src/features/settings/components/ThemeSwitcher.tsx
- src/features/settings/components/ThemeSwitcher.css.ts
- src/features/settings/components/ThemeSwitcher.test.tsx

FILES MODIFIED:
- src/features/settings/components/sections/GeneralSection.tsx — remove Appearance card block
- src/features/settings/components/index.ts — remove ThemeSwitcher export
- src/features/settings/types.ts — remove ThemeMode type + themeMode field from Settings interface
- src/App.tsx — replace both theme useEffects with single: document.documentElement.classList.add(darkTheme)
- src/styles/theme.css.ts — delete lightTheme definition (lines 94-178)
- src/styles/index.ts — remove lightTheme export
- src/index.css — remove theme transition CSS (~lines 130-135)
- src-tauri/src/features/settings/types.rs — ThemeMode default → Dark (enum kept for backwards compat)
- src-tauri/src/features/settings/ui_preferences.rs — default theme_mode → ThemeMode::Dark

NOTE: src/utils/telemetry.ts darkMode property left alone — it detects OS preference as metadata, independent of app theme

REVISIT WHEN: Never, unless light mode is explicitly re-requested
